limits: Browser-native touch emulation and software WebGL are not physical-phone performance or Safari verification.
Application clock clamps long frame deltas and pauses; automated wall time includes software rendering, screenshots and test interaction. Neither measures a normal human three-minute journey.
AI legibility review is not a human learning-outcome or retention study.
Original theatrical layout, people, dialogue, local attacks, workshop, school and pattern are fiction.
Audio signal measurements do not establish pleasantness on phone speakers or an independent listening test.

unaided_ui_review.scope: Bounded AI legibility and exploration check; not a human learning or native-performance test
unaided_ui_review.method: Unaided visible-UI ordinary keyboard/mouse, no hooks/source/walkthrough
unaided_ui_review.binding_note: Lead verified frozen F hashes across the attempt; the reviewer did not read source or hashes. This is historical F legibility evidence; G changes warning HUD and landscape caption layout.

comprehension.whoWhyWhere: Raka, neighbor to Sari, is helping Sari and her younger brother Adi evacuate from a Surabaya street in November1945 to a school across the river amid fighting after Indonesian independence.
comprehension.culturalPracticeObjectRelation: Canting drips malam, batik wax. Holding/stretching cloth and seeing pale motif lines persist against dark dyed fabric makes wax-resist legible. Sari teaches Adi as an older sister in an everyday neighborhood stall.
comprehension.whyHelpingMatters: The siblings need to stay together and escape danger; the title instruction not to let go of Adi's hand makes separation a personal risk. Helping begins with shared work and becomes civilian evacuation.
comprehension.knowledgeLimits: This understanding comes from visible entry text, objectives, subtitles and cloth/scene appearance. It is an AI reading result; it does not establish historical learning by a human. No ending or later cultural material observed.

findings.finding: Role, neighbor/sibling relationships, destination and immediate civilian stakes were explicit on entry.
Canting→wax→color-resist explanation aligns with the cloth interaction and visibly contrasting motif lines.
Burning rubble and large right-alley instruction make the detour reason clear; pause menu is useful for recovery.
Repeated E holds and the change from stretch cloth to hold/look at line did not make the precise completion condition obvious. Under software rendering the first dialogue stayed visible for minutes.
I continued toward the global alley objective after a resident asked to crouch/wait; a later explicit cover banner made the warning harder to miss.
No drag command was available. Click→move had no clear turning effect, so rightward inspection/navigation was constrained. This does not prove a production control bug.
Software renderer and earlier orphan contention dominated wall time; no general native performance conclusion is justified.

stop.warning: BERLINDUNG — Dari depan · cari tembok atau peti
stop.reason: Parent bounded this exploration after concrete story/culture/chaos/missed-prompt observations. The generic fixture lacked mouse-down/up or drag commands; click followed by move did not visibly turn the view. Subsequent crouch+D produced no marker change. This is an input-fixture/navigation limitation, not a proved game trap.
stop.completionClaim: The river crossing, school arrival and ending were not observed.

limits: Includes screenshot capture, waits, interpretation, infrastructure diagnosis and pause/settings inspection.
Earlier orphan non-TTY browser contended until exact retained session73001 was closed with Ctrl-C; current game session13573 was preserved.
Software rendering advanced movement/dialogue very slowly. Screenshots took roughly tens of seconds. These timings are not human completion time.
